parts.invalid: Small red badge beside the running lap time in every HUD layout: the lap was cut (track limits) and won't count. One short word; it is shown in capitals.
phone.timing: Screen-reader name of the phone HUD's timing panel (position, lap, lap time).
phone.outLap: Big heading of the phone HUD's timing panel on the lap out of the pits or grid, before a timed lap starts. Fits about 10 characters.
phone.lapOrRun: Big heading of the phone HUD's timing panel in practice. {kind} is 'run' on a hill climb (a timed run from start to finish), otherwise a circuit lap. {lap}: the lap or run number. Fits about 10 characters.
phone.raceLap: Small label of the phone HUD in a race. {lap}: the lap number. Shown in capitals, fits about 10 characters.
phone.raceLapOfTotal: Small label of the phone HUD in a race. {lap}: the lap number, {total}: the race distance in laps (e.g. 'Lap 3/10'). Shown in capitals, fits about 10 characters.
phone.best: Label before the best lap time on the phone HUD. Shown in capitals, fits about 6 characters.
broadcast.timingTower: Screen-reader name of the race standings panel (the list of cars by position) in the Broadcast and Telemetry HUD layouts.
broadcast.session: Screen-reader name of the practice lap-time card in the Broadcast and Telemetry HUD layouts.
broadcast.outLap: Heading of the lap-time card on the lap out of the pits or grid, before a timed lap starts. Fits about 16 characters.
broadcast.raceLap: Heading of the race standings panel. {lap}: the current lap number. Fits about 16 characters.
broadcast.raceLapOfTotal: Heading of the race standings panel, e.g. 'Lap 3/10'. {lap}: the current lap, {total}: the race distance in laps. Keep the <dim></dim> tags around the '/{total}' part; they draw it fainter.
broadcast.sessionLap: Heading of the practice lap-time card, e.g. 'Practice · Lap 3'. {session}: the session name (Practice, Qualifying, Time trial), already translated. {kind} is 'run' on a hill climb (a timed run from start to finish), otherwise a circuit lap. Keep the <dim></dim> tags; they draw the lap part fainter. Fits about 22 characters.
broadcast.best: Label before the best lap time. Shown in small capitals, fits about 6 characters.
broadcast.last: Label before the last lap's time. Shown in small capitals, fits about 6 characters.
broadcast.circuitMap: Screen-reader name of the circuit map card.
broadcast.sector: Under the circuit map: which third of the lap the car is in. {sector}: 1, 2 or 3. Shown in small capitals.
broadcast.sectorTitle: Hover text under the circuit map. {sector}: 1, 2 or 3. {corner}: the corner's name (not translated) or the word for Straight, already translated.
broadcast.straight: Under the circuit map, in place of a corner's number while the car is between corners (on a straight). Shown in small capitals, fits about 10 characters.
broadcast.chasing: Label in the small pill over the speed pod in a race, before the code of the car ahead you are chasing and the gap to it. Shown in small capitals.
broadcast.tyreTemps: Screen-reader description of the four small tyre temperature tiles.
broadcast.fuel: Label over the fuel on board (kg) in the speed pod. Shown in small capitals, fits about 8 characters.
broadcast.delta: Label over the live time difference to your best lap (e.g. -0.23). Shown in small capitals, fits about 10 characters.
broadcast.predicted: Label over the lap time you are on course for (best lap plus the live difference). Shown in small capitals, fits about 10 characters.
broadcast.quicker: Screen-reader text of the arrow beside the predicted lap: this lap is quicker than your best so far.
broadcast.slower: Screen-reader text of the arrow beside the predicted lap: this lap is slower than your best so far.
wheelDash.wheelDash: Screen-reader name of the Wheel Dash: the steering-wheel display at the bottom of the screen.
wheelDash.shiftLights: Screen-reader text of the shift lights (the row of lights that fill up as the engine revs). {lit}: lights on now, {total}: lights in the row.
wheelDash.speed: Label of the speed cell on the steering-wheel display. {unit}: km/h or mph, not translated. Shown in small capitals.
wheelDash.ersBattery: Label of the hybrid battery cell on the steering-wheel display. ERS = Energy Recovery System; keep ERS. Shown in small capitals, fits about 14 characters.
wheelDash.deploy: Abbreviation in the battery cell: the hybrid is deploying (spending battery energy for power). Keep it to 3 or 4 capital letters.
wheelDash.harvest: Abbreviation in the battery cell: the hybrid is harvesting (charging the battery under braking or lifting). Keep it to 3 or 4 capital letters.
wheelDash.idle: In the battery cell: the hybrid is neither deploying nor harvesting. One short word, fits about 5 characters.
wheelDash.topSpeed: Label of the cell with the highest speed reached this lap (cars without a hybrid). Shown in small capitals.
wheelDash.gear: Label over the gear number in the middle of the steering-wheel display. Shown in small capitals, fits about 6 characters.
wheelDash.delta: Label of the cell with the live time difference to your best lap. Shown in small capitals, fits about 10 characters.
wheelDash.lap: Label of the lap-time cell for a few seconds after a lap is completed, over that lap's time. Shown in small capitals, fits about 8 characters.
wheelDash.lapTime: Label of the lap-time cell over the running lap's clock. Shown in small capitals, fits about 10 characters.
wheelDash.best: Label before the best lap time. Shown in small capitals, fits about 6 characters.
wheelDash.ahead: Label in a race before the gap to the car ahead. Shown in small capitals, fits about 6 characters.
wheelDash.last: Label before the last lap's time (practice). Shown in small capitals, fits about 6 characters.
wheelDash.lead: Shown in place of the gap to the car ahead when you are leading the race. Fits about 6 characters.
wheelDash.fuel: Label before the fuel on board (kg). Shown in small capitals, fits about 6 characters.
wheelDash.tagLap: Small label over the lap number in the position tag at the top left of the Wheel Dash layout. Shown in small capitals, fits about 5 characters.
telemetry.lapAnalysis: Screen-reader name of the Telemetry layout's sector table (sector times of this lap and the best ones).
telemetry.thisLap: Column heading of the sector table: the sector times of the lap being driven. Shown in small capitals, fits about 10 characters.
telemetry.best: Column heading of the sector table: the best time for each sector. Shown in small capitals, fits about 10 characters.
telemetry.idealLap: Label over the sum of your best sector times (the lap you could do putting them together). Shown in small capitals.
telemetry.topSpeed: Label over the top speed this lap and the highest ever. {unit}: km/h or mph, not translated. Shown in small capitals, fits about 12 characters.
telemetry.gPower: Screen-reader name of the card with the g-force circle, power and aero numbers.
telemetry.lateral: Row label: sideways g-force (cornering). Shown in small capitals, fits about 8 characters.
telemetry.longitudinal: Row label, short for longitudinal: forward/backward g-force (braking and accelerating). Shown in small capitals, fits about 8 characters.
telemetry.downforce: Row label, short for downforce (the aerodynamic load pressing the car down, in kg). Shown in small capitals, fits about 8 characters; an abbreviation is fine.
telemetry.power: Row label: the engine's total power output (kW). Shown in small capitals, fits about 8 characters.
telemetry.drag: Row label: aerodynamic drag (kN). Shown in small capitals, fits about 8 characters.
telemetry.fuel: Row label: fuel on board (kg). Shown in small capitals, fits about 8 characters.
telemetry.tyres: Screen-reader name of the tyre and brake temperature panel.
irDashies.standings: Screen-reader name of the race standings panel (irDashies HUD layout).
irDashies.race: Session name at the left of the bar over the race standings. Fits about 8 characters.
irDashies.out: In the gap column of the standings: this car has retired from the race. Fits about 4 characters.
irDashies.finished: Screen-reader text of the chequered-flag icon in the standings: this car has finished the race.
irDashies.lapTimer: Screen-reader name of the practice lap timer panel.
irDashies.sessionBest: Small label over the best lap time of the session in the lap timer. Shown in capitals, fits about 10 characters.
irDashies.lastLap: Small label over the last completed lap's time in the lap timer. Shown in capitals, fits about 10 characters.
irDashies.historyLap: Row of the lap history list, e.g. 'LAP 4'. {lap}: the lap number. Written in capitals; fits about 7 characters.
irDashies.shiftLights: Screen-reader text of the shift lights (the row of lights that fill up as the engine revs). {lit}: lights on now, {total}: lights in the row.
irDashies.aidOff: Value in the small TC (traction control) and ABS cells: the driving aid is switched off. Fits about 4 characters.
irDashies.fuel: Label of the small fuel cell beside the pedals (cars without a hybrid). Fits about 8 characters.
irDashies.inputs: Screen-reader name of the inputs panel (pedals, gear, speed, steering wheel).
irDashies.weather: Screen-reader name of the weather panel.
irDashies.trackConditions: Heading at the right of the weather panel's bar when the time of day is fixed (it shows the clock when time moves): the panel shows the track's conditions. Fits about 10 characters.
irDashies.air: Small label over the air temperature. Shown in capitals, fits about 6 characters.
irDashies.trackTemp: Small label over the track (road surface) temperature. Shown in capitals, fits about 6 characters.
irDashies.lights: Small label over the car's headlight state (On, Off, Flash). Shown in capitals, fits about 6 characters.
irDashies.liveDelta: Screen-reader name of the bar showing the live time difference to your best lap.
irDashies.radar: Screen-reader name of the proximity radar (the cars close around you, seen from above).
h2h.notAvailable: Head to Head HUD layout: shown in place of a gap or a lap-time difference when there is none yet (not available). Fits about 6 characters.
h2h.best: Small caption under a driver's best lap time. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 6 characters.
h2h.last: Small caption under a driver's last lap time. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 6 characters.
h2h.gap: Small caption under the time gap to the car ahead or behind. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 6 characters.
h2h.deltaLap: Small caption under the difference between your last lap and that car's last lap. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 10 characters.
h2h.raceLeader: Shown in the card for the car ahead when you are leading the race (there is no car ahead). Shown in widely spaced capitals, fits about 14 characters.
h2h.lastPlace: Shown in the card for the car behind when you are last (there is no car behind). Shown in widely spaced capitals, fits about 14 characters.
h2h.you: Shown in place of your name on your own card (always in practice). Fits about 10 characters.
h2h.lapPlace: Under your name on your card in practice. {lap}: the current lap number.
h2h.runningLap: Small caption under the running lap's clock in practice. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.runningInvalid: Caption under the running lap's clock when the lap was cut (track limits) and won't count. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.delta: Small caption under the live time difference to your best lap. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.brakeBias: Label of the brake bias cell (how the braking force is split front/rear, in %). Short for Brake Bias; shown in widely spaced capitals, fits about 3 letters.
h2h.fuel: Label of the fuel cell beside the gear. Shown in widely spaced capitals, fits about 5 characters.
h2h.aidOff: Value in the ABS and TC (traction control) cells: the driving aid is switched off. Written in capitals, fits about 4 characters.
h2h.gear: Label over the gear number. Shown in widely spaced capitals, fits about 5 characters.
h2h.car: Screen-reader name of the panel with the car's cells (gear, speed, aids, fuel).
h2h.fuelPanel: Screen-reader name of the fuel panel.
h2h.fuelLevel: Heading in the fuel panel over the fuel on board (kg). Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 12 characters.
h2h.remaining: Heading in the fuel panel over how long the fuel lasts (hh:mm:ss). Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 12 characters.
h2h.perLap: Heading in the fuel panel over the fuel used per lap (kg). Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.laps: Heading in the fuel panel over how many laps the fuel lasts. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.atFlag: Heading in the fuel panel over the fuel left at the chequered flag (the end of the race), at the current use. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.alongside: Screen-reader text of the spotter bars that appear while another car is beside yours. {side}: which side.
h2h.left: Pill over the left spotter bar: a car is alongside on your left. Fits about 6 characters.
h2h.right: Pill over the right spotter bar: a car is alongside on your right. Fits about 6 characters.
h2h.weather: Screen-reader name of the weather card.
h2h.air: Heading over the air temperature. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 6 characters.
h2h.track: Heading over the track (road surface) temperature. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 6 characters.
h2h.surface: Heading over the track surface state (Dry, Damp, Wet). Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.rain: Heading over how hard it is raining (%). Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.time: Heading over the time of day. Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.timeFixed: Under the Time heading when the time of day doesn't move. Written in capitals, fits about 6 characters.
h2h.lights: Heading over the car's headlight state (On, Off, Flash). Shown in tracked capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.liveDelta: Screen-reader name of the bar showing the live time difference to your best lap.
h2h.barInvalid: Label of the live delta bar when the lap was cut (track limits) and won't count. Shown in capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.barDelta: Label of the live delta bar (the time difference to your best lap). Shown in capitals, fits about 8 characters.
h2h.headToHead: Screen-reader name of the stack of cards: the car ahead, you, the car behind.
h2h.lapCard: Screen-reader name of your lap card in practice.
blocks.out: Blocks HUD layout, gap column of the race leaderboard: the car has retired. Fits about 9 characters.
blocks.finished: Gap column of the leaderboard: the car has finished the race. Fits about 9 characters.
blocks.leader: Gap column of the leaderboard, on the leading car's row. Fits about 9 characters.
blocks.lapsDown: Gap column of the leaderboard: the car is this many laps behind the leader. Fits about 9 characters.
blocks.leaderboard: Screen-reader name of the race leaderboard.
blocks.headPos: Column heading of the leaderboard, short for Position. Fits about 4 characters.
blocks.headName: Column heading of the leaderboard: the driver's name. Fits about 8 characters.
blocks.headLap: Column heading of the leaderboard: the lap the car is on. Fits about 3 characters; an abbreviation is fine.
blocks.headLast: Column heading of the leaderboard: the car's last lap time. Fits about 9 characters.
blocks.headBest: Column heading of the leaderboard: the car's best lap time. Fits about 9 characters.
blocks.headGap: Column heading of the leaderboard: the time gap to the leader. Fits about 9 characters.
blocks.headInterval: Column heading of the leaderboard: the time gap to the car directly ahead. Fits about 9 characters.
blocks.you: Shown in place of your own name on your leaderboard row. Fits about 8 characters.
blocks.sectors: Screen-reader name of the bar of the three sectors (thirds of the lap) at the top centre.
blocks.raceFinished: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals): the race is over.
blocks.vsc: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals) during a Virtual Safety Car. VSC = Virtual Safety Car; keep VSC if your language uses it. {delta}: how far ahead (−) or behind (+) the required pace you are, in seconds, e.g. +0.42.
blocks.vscEnding: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals): the Virtual Safety Car period is ending. Keep VSC. {delta}: how far ahead (−) or behind (+) the required pace you are, in seconds.
blocks.doubleYellow: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals): double yellow flags, slow down, no overtaking.
blocks.yellowFlag: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals): yellow flag, danger ahead, no overtaking.
blocks.offTrackStrikes: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals): you went off track. {warnings}: track-limit strikes so far, {limit}: strikes before a penalty.
blocks.offTrack: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals): you went off track (beyond the track limits).
blocks.lapDeleted: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals): this lap's time won't count because you cut the track.
blocks.blueFlagYield: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals): blue flag, a faster car lapping you must be let past now. {driver}: that car's three-letter code.
blocks.blueFlagLetThrough: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals): blue flag, a faster car is coming to lap you. {driver}: that car's three-letter code.
blocks.lastLap: Banner under the sector bar (shown in capitals): this is the final lap of the race.
blocks.deltaAria: Screen-reader name of the delta block (the live time difference to your best lap).
blocks.deltaBest: Label of the live time difference to your best lap. Fits about 10 characters.
blocks.predicted: Label of the lap time you are on course for. Fits about 10 characters.
blocks.position: Label of the block with your race position (e.g. 03/20). Shown in capitals, fits about 9 characters.
blocks.laps: Label of the block with the lap count. Shown in capitals; the block is narrow, fits about 5 characters.
blocks.race: Label of the session clock block in a race. Shown in capitals.
blocks.lapTiming: Screen-reader name of the lap timing blocks.
blocks.currentTime: Label over the running lap's time. Shown in capitals, fits about 14 characters.
blocks.invalid: Beside 'Current time' when the lap was cut (track limits) and won't count. Shown in capitals.
blocks.best: Label of your best lap time. Shown in capitals, fits about 5 characters.
blocks.last: Label of your last lap time. Shown in capitals, fits about 5 characters.
blocks.ideal: Label of your ideal lap (the sum of your best sector times). Shown in capitals, fits about 5 characters.
blocks.lapHistory: Screen-reader name of the lap history table.
blocks.historyLap: Column heading of the lap history table: the lap number. Fits about 3 characters.
blocks.historyTime: Column heading of the lap history table: the lap time. Fits about 8 characters.
blocks.historyDeltaBest: Column heading of the lap history table: the difference to your best lap. Fits about 9 characters.
blocks.essentials: Screen-reader name of the block with speed, gear and engine rpm.
blocks.forceFeedback: Label inside the force feedback bar (how hard the steering wheel motor is pushing). Shown in capitals, fits about 18 characters.
blocks.clutch: Label inside the clutch pedal bar. Shown in capitals.
blocks.brake: Label inside the brake pedal bar. Shown in capitals.
blocks.throttle: Label inside the throttle pedal bar. Shown in capitals.
blocks.inputs: Screen-reader name of the inputs block (steering, pedals, driving aids).
blocks.aidOff: Value of the ABS and TC (traction control) cells: the aid is switched off. Written in capitals, fits about 4 characters.
blocks.brakeBias: Label of the brake bias cell (front/rear braking split, %). Short for Brake Bias; fits about 3 letters.
blocks.turbo: Label of the turbo boost cell (bar of boost). Short for Turbo; fits about 3 letters.
blocks.fuel: Screen-reader name of the fuel block.
blocks.fuelRemaining: Label of the fuel block over the fuel on board (kg). Shown in capitals, fits about 16 characters.
blocks.fuelLaps: Beside the fuel on board: how many laps it lasts. {laps}: a number with one decimal, e.g. 4.2.
blocks.tyres: Screen-reader name of the tyres block.
blocks.weather: Heading of the weather block (shown in capitals), and its screen-reader name.
blocks.rain: Right side of the weather heading while it rains. {pct}: how hard it is raining, 0 to 100. Written in capitals.
blocks.air: Small label over the air temperature. Shown in capitals, fits about 6 characters.
blocks.track: Small label over the track (road surface) temperature. Shown in capitals, fits about 6 characters.
blocks.surface: Small label over the track surface state (Dry, Damp, Wet), short for Surface. Shown in capitals, fits about 6 characters.
blocks.lights: Small label over the car's headlight state (On, Off, Flash). Shown in capitals, fits about 6 characters.
blocks.radar: Screen-reader name of the proximity radar (the cars close around you, seen from above).
raceVision.classField: RaceVision HUD layout: the slanted class pill over the standings when the car's class is unknown (the whole field). One short word, fits about 8 characters.
raceVision.classRoad: Class pill over the standings: a road car. One short word, fits about 8 characters.
raceVision.classProto: Class pill over the standings: a prototype sports car (Le Mans style). Short form, fits about 8 characters.
raceVision.classClassic: Class pill over the standings: a historic racing car. One short word, fits about 8 characters.
raceVision.classFormula: Class pill over the standings: a single-seater formula car. One short word, fits about 8 characters.
raceVision.standings: Screen-reader name of the race standings window.
raceVision.laps: Screen-reader name of the practice window listing the laps driven.
raceVision.race: Heading of the standings window in a race. Written in capitals; fits about 12 characters.
raceVision.sessionTime: Screen-reader text of the session clock. {time}: time on track, e.g. 12:34.
raceVision.cars: Screen-reader text of the helmet icon beside the number of cars in the session.
raceVision.out: Gap column of the standings: the car has retired. Written in capitals; fits about 4 characters.
raceVision.finished: Gap column of the standings: the car has finished the race (short for finished). Written in capitals; fits about 4 characters.
raceVision.invalid: Shown in place of the running lap time when the lap was cut (track limits) and won't count. Written in capitals; fits about 10 characters.
raceVision.invalidShort: In the lap list, beside a lap that didn't count (cut track limits). Short for INVALID; written in capitals; fits about 4 characters.
raceVision.relative: Screen-reader name of the relative window: the cars nearest you on the road, with the gaps in seconds.
raceVision.strikes: Hover text over the track-limit strike count (e.g. 2x): how many times you've broken track limits.
raceVision.fuelLaps: Footer of the relative window: how many more laps the fuel lasts. {laps}: a number with one decimal, e.g. 4.2. The ~ means about.
raceVision.raceLaps: Footer of the relative window. {lap}: the current race lap.
raceVision.raceLapsOfTotal: Footer of the relative window, e.g. 'Laps 3/10'. {lap}: the current race lap, {total}: the race distance in laps.
raceVision.aidWorking: Screen-reader text of the TC (traction control) or ABS light while the aid is acting. {aid}: TC or ABS.
raceVision.inputs: Screen-reader name of the inputs pill (gear, shift lights, speed, rpm).
raceVision.shiftLights: Screen-reader text of the shift lights (the row of lights that fill up as the engine revs). {lit}: lights on now, {total}: lights in the row.
raceVision.delta: Small label over the live time difference to your best lap. Written in capitals; fits about 6 characters.
raceVision.aero: Small label over the active aerodynamics state (2026 cars, whose wings open on straights). Written in capitals; fits about 6 characters.
raceVision.open: Aero or DRS state: the wing flap is open. Written in capitals; fits about 6 characters.
raceVision.queued: Aero or DRS state: it will open at the next activation point. Written in capitals; fits about 6 characters.
raceVision.armed: Aero or DRS state: allowed, ready to open. Written in capitals; fits about 6 characters.
raceVision.shut: Aero or DRS state: closed, not available. Written in capitals; fits about 6 characters.
raceVision.inputGraph: Screen-reader name of the graph of throttle and brake over the last seconds.
raceVision.weather: Screen-reader name of the weather strip.
raceVision.air: Small label over the air temperature. Written in capitals; fits about 4 characters.
raceVision.track: Small label over the track (road surface) temperature, short for TRACK. Written in capitals; fits about 4 characters.
raceVision.surface: Small label over the track surface state (Dry, Damp, Wet), short for SURFACE. Written in capitals; fits about 4 characters.
raceVision.rain: Small label over how hard it is raining (%). Written in capitals; fits about 4 characters.
raceVision.lights: Small label over the car's headlight state (On, Off, Flash), short for LIGHTS. Written in capitals; fits about 4 characters.
raceVision.radar: Screen-reader name of the proximity radar (the cars close around you, seen from above).
retro.aidOff: Retro UI HUD layout: value in the TC (traction control) and ABS cells under the round dial: the aid is switched off. Written in capitals; the cell is tiny, at most 4 letters.
retro.fuel: Label of the fuel cell under the round dial. Written in capitals; the cell is tiny, at most 4 letters.
retro.aero: Label of the active aerodynamics cell under the round dial (2026 cars). Written in capitals; at most 4 letters.
retro.open: Value of the DRS cell under the round dial: the rear wing flap is open. Written in capitals; at most 4 letters.
retro.armed: Value of the DRS cell under the round dial: DRS is allowed, ready to open (short for ARMED). Written in capitals; at most 4 letters.
retro.shut: Value of the DRS cell under the round dial: the flap is closed. Written in capitals; at most 4 letters.
retro.brakeBias: Label of the brake bias cell under the round dial (front/rear braking split, %). Short for Brake Bias; at most 3 letters.
retro.dial: Screen-reader text of the round dial. {speed}: the speed, {unit}: km/h or mph (not translated), {gear}: the gear (R, N, 1, 2…), {rpm}: engine revolutions per minute.
retro.liveDelta: Small label under the big live time difference to your best lap. Shown in capitals.
retro.current: Short for CURRENT: label before the running lap's clock in the delta bar. Written in capitals; about 3 letters.
retro.invalid: In the delta bar when the lap was cut (track limits) and won't count. Written in capitals; fits about 8 characters.
retro.lapNumber: In the delta bar: the lap number, padded to two digits ({lap} is e.g. '03'). Written in capitals; fits about 7 characters.
retro.personalBest: Short for PERSONAL BEST: label before your best lap time. Written in capitals; about 2 or 3 letters.
retro.sessionBestShort: Short for SESSION best: label before the best lap of the session. Written in capitals; about 3 letters.
retro.sessionBest: Small label over the best lap time of the session (race). Shown in capitals, fits about 14 characters.
retro.yourBest: Small label over your own best lap time (race). Shown in capitals, fits about 14 characters.
retro.headPos: Column heading of the relative panel, short for POSITION. Written in capitals; about 3 letters.
retro.headDriver: Column heading of the relative panel: the driver's name. Written in capitals.
retro.headGap: Column heading of the relative panel: the time gap on the road. Written in capitals; about 3 letters.
retro.lapsInvalid: Beside the running lap's clock in practice when the lap was cut (track limits) and won't count. Written in capitals.
retro.noLaps: In the practice lap list before any lap is completed.
retro.lapBest: Tag beside a lap in the lap list: your best lap. Written in capitals; about 4 letters.
retro.lapCut: Tag beside a lap in the lap list: the lap was cut (track limits) and doesn't count. Written in capitals; about 4 letters.
retro.puncture: In the car condition panel: a tyre is punctured. Written in capitals.
retro.terminal: In the car condition panel, in place of the damage %: the damage is terminal, the car is out of the race. Written in capitals; about 4 letters.
retro.sectorTitle: Hover text under the circuit map. {sector}: 1, 2 or 3. {corner}: the corner's name (not translated) or the word for Straight, already translated.
retro.straight: Under the circuit map, in place of a corner's number while the car is between corners (on a straight). Fits about 10 characters.
retro.air: Small label over the air temperature. Shown in capitals, fits about 8 characters.
retro.track: Small label over the track (road surface) temperature. Shown in capitals, fits about 8 characters.
retro.surface: Small label over the track surface state (Dry, Damp, Wet). Shown in capitals, fits about 8 characters.
retro.rain: Small label over how hard it is raining (%). Shown in capitals, fits about 8 characters.
retro.clock: Small label over the time of day. Shown in capitals, fits about 8 characters.
retro.clockFixed: Under the Clock label when the time of day doesn't move. Written in capitals; about 5 letters.
retro.lights: Small label over the car's headlight state (On, Off, Flash). Shown in capitals, fits about 8 characters.
retro.radar: Screen-reader name of the proximity radar (the cars close around you, seen from above).
grandPrix.sessionFinished: Grand Prix HUD layout: session bar of the timing tower once the race is over. Written in capitals; fits about 12 characters.
grandPrix.sessionRace: Session bar of the timing tower during a race. Written in capitals; fits about 12 characters.
grandPrix.sessionQualifying: Session bar of the timing tower in qualifying. Written in capitals; fits about 12 characters.
grandPrix.sessionOutLap: Session bar of the timing tower on the lap out of the pits or grid, before a timed lap starts. Written in capitals; fits about 12 characters.
grandPrix.turn: Tiny curved label on the halo display (the cockpit TV camera view) over the number of the corner you are in. Written in capitals; about 4 letters.
grandPrix.straight: On the halo display, in place of the corner number between corners. Short for STRAIGHT; written in capitals; at most 3 letters.
grandPrix.recharge: Tiny vertical label beside the brake bar on the halo display: braking recharges the hybrid battery. Written in capitals; about 8 letters.
grandPrix.brake: Tiny label under the brake bar on the halo display. Written in capitals; about 6 letters.
grandPrix.boost: Tiny label over the hybrid boost meter in the speed pod. Written in capitals; about 5 letters.
grandPrix.drsOpen: Pill in the speed pod while the DRS rear wing flap is open. Keep DRS. Written in capitals; fits about 9 characters.
grandPrix.overtake: Pill in the speed pod of a hybrid car: the overtake mode (extra electric power) indicator. Written in capitals; fits about 9 characters.
grandPrix.deploy: Tiny vertical label beside the throttle bar on the halo display: the throttle deploys hybrid energy. Written in capitals; about 8 letters.
grandPrix.throttle: Tiny label under the throttle bar on the halo display. Written in capitals; about 8 letters.
grandPrix.activeAero: Tiny label over the moving-wing drawing on the halo display (2026 cars' wings open on straights). Written in capitals; about 11 characters.
grandPrix.aeroOpen: Under the moving-wing drawing: the wing is open (low drag). Written in capitals; about 6 letters.
grandPrix.aeroClosed: Under the moving-wing drawing: the wing is closed (high downforce). Written in capitals; about 6 letters.
grandPrix.gears: Tiny curved label over the row of gear numbers on the halo display. Written in capitals; about 5 letters.
grandPrix.battery: Label inside the left ring of the bottom cluster: the hybrid battery charge. Short for BATTERY; written in capitals; about 4 letters.
grandPrix.fuel: Label inside the left ring of the bottom cluster on a car without a hybrid: fuel on board. Written in capitals; about 4 letters.
grandPrix.tyreWear: Tiny label beside the tyre wear rings on the car diagram. Written in capitals; about 9 characters.
grandPrix.ersOvertake: Status under the car diagram: the overtake mode (extra electric power) is on. Written in capitals; about 9 characters.
grandPrix.ersDeploy: Status under the car diagram: the hybrid is in its normal deploy mode. Written in capitals; about 9 characters.
grandPrix.youCode: Your three-letter code in the timing tower when you have no code of your own. Written in capitals; at most 3 or 4 letters.
grandPrix.youName: Your name on the driver card and the halo display when you have no player name. Written in capitals; fits about 11 characters.
grandPrix.towerLap: Head of the timing tower. {lap}: the current lap. Written in capitals; fits about 10 characters.
grandPrix.towerLapOfTotal: Head of the timing tower, e.g. 'LAP 3/10'. {lap}: the current lap, {total}: the race distance in laps. Written in capitals; fits about 10 characters.
grandPrix.towerOut: Gap column of the timing tower: the car has retired. Written in capitals; about 4 letters.
grandPrix.towerLast: Code column of the timing tower in practice, on the row with your last lap time. Written in capitals; about 4 letters.
grandPrix.fastestLap: Small purple badge on the driver card: you hold the fastest lap of the race. Short for FASTEST LAP; written in capitals; at most 2 or 3 letters.
grandPrix.finished: Small badge on the driver card: you have finished the race (short for FINISHED). Written in capitals; about 3 letters.
grandPrix.bestRef: Small line on the driver card: your best lap, the reference for the delta. {time}: a lap time such as 1:23.456. Written in capitals.
grandPrix.noRef: Small line on the driver card before you have a best lap: no reference lap for the delta yet. Written in capitals; fits about 14 characters.
grandPrix.stripLap: Lap strip of the session card (standard camera). {lap}: the current lap. Written in capitals.
grandPrix.stripLapOfTotal: Lap strip of the session card (standard camera), e.g. 'LAP 3 / 10'. {lap}: the current lap, {total}: the race distance in laps. Written in capitals.
grandPrix.standingsOut: Gap column of the session card's standings: the car has retired. Written in capitals; about 4 letters.
grandPrix.lastLap: Row of the session card in practice, beside your last lap time. Written in capitals.
grandPrix.delta: Label of the delta bar (the live time difference to your best lap). Written in capitals; about 6 letters.
grandPrix.brakeBias: Label in the setup card: the brake bias (front/rear braking split, %). Written in capitals.
gtLike.boost: GT-Like HUD gauge label: turbo boost pressure in bar (not the hybrid Boost button).
f1Like.ers.clipped: ERS state: the hybrid has run out of deployable energy on a straight and power drops (not force-feedback clipping).
f1Like.ers.neutral: ERS state: neither harvesting nor deploying (not the gearbox neutral).
f1Like.overtake: The 2026 Overtake Mode: use the same word as the Overtake button elsewhere in the game.
